correctness.rationale: The explicit Phi_m columns satisfy Phi_m*Phi_m=I2 from chi3 orthogonality and sum_m P_m=2 I7. Affine relabelling acts unitarily; the affine group of F7 has two four-subset orbits of sizes 21 and 14. The pinned checker faithfully represents Z[zeta7,omega3] as rank-12 integer cyclotomic module (basis 0..5 in zeta and 0..1 in omega), forms B=42 T^{-1}(sum P_m)T and computes each of 35 seven-degree characteristic polynomials exactly from integer traces/Newton identities. Factored polynomials (t-84)((t-42)^2-1176)(((t-42)^2-294)^2 and (t-84)((t-42)^2-1029)(((t-42)^4-735(t-42)^2+21609) yield every listed eigenvalue and positive bound. An independent floating-point reconstruction classified all 35 subsets 21/14 and worst eigenvalue 0.183503419072..., supplementary to exact cyclotomic certificate. Three planes cannot span dimension seven.
